decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint is close to the core pipeline-fitting business and uses existing welding and coating capabilities, so the firm keeps it as part of its established range.

The ceiling or floor pipe bracket builds on existing fabrication skills, the firm committed to it publicly with its own page, and it fits the announced range expansion, so management persists with it.
The pipe support bracket is a low-cost extension of the core infrastructure offering, and its sunk investment and visible presentation favour keeping it.

Although the public waste bin is distant from the core business, it uses the firm's powder-coating investment and was publicly launched as a line, so weak results are likely put down to slow municipal procurement in the pandemic years rather than a failed course.

The multi-model waste bin line with ashtray represents a visible commitment to the street-furniture diversification and shares coating capacity, so management holds on and attributes disappointing sales to temporary causes.
The outdoor ashtray line is part of the same publicly announced diversification into municipal outdoor products, and the investment in several models makes management reluctant to abandon it so soon.
